Located in the highest position in Jinzhou, the '''City Hall''' stands as the paramount political hub, housing the vital data repository — the Grand Library. Since the establishment of [[Jinzhou]], it has served as the residence of every Jinzhou Magistrate. The current Magistrate of Jinzhou is [[Jinhsi]].
